⛅ Welcome to Kawaii Dress Up Obby! ⛅

Please Favorite & 👍 Thumbs Up 👍 for future content!

🏰 This Obby is designed for Replaying, the Levels do NOT save so you can Dress Up again! 🏰
🥇 Collect Kawaii Badges on every Level 🥇
🎀 Complete Sections to unlock Dress Up & Accessories 🎀
✨ 10 Free Trails to earn along the way! ✨
📷 Finish the Obby with a Fashion Show & Photoshoot 📷
⭐ Repeat the Obby for different looks each time ⭐
👑 Climb the Leaderboard to show you have Kawaii Style 👑 
🏆 Badges & Trophy Trail Awards as you Level Up! 🏆
💯 Complete the Obby for Bonus Levels 💯
🎁 Some Badge Descriptions give Hints to complete the Level 🎁
🛒 Gamepasses Unlock ~30 Extra Trails & ~Speed Giver 🛒

 🌟BONUS🌟 Joining the Community unlocks Member's Only areas for Animations, Trails, Outfits & Hair!  🌟
Kawaii Roleplay Games Community Link: https://www.roblox.com/groups/4344260

💟 Thanks for playing! Find all my games on my Profile Favs or Creations Tab! 💟
   ~CraftyJackie~  Ü
